correctness.rationale: Lucas parity turns f(s) into product of independent biased signs over the Boolean downset D(s), size 2^popcount(s). For s≠t the symmetric difference contains at least 2^min(popcount(s),popcount(t)) coefficients. Uniform |1−2p_k|≤q<1 bounds scenery correlations by q^distance. Few low-popcount indices imply E|m^-1Σ_(s<m)f(s)|²=O(m^-δ), δ=1/(8log2)>1/12; on m_j=ceil(j^12) Chebyshev sums, Borel–Cantelli, and m_(j+1)/m_j→1 give a.e. spatial Cesàro zero. Independent geometric holding times at every visited state transfer this to almost-sure conditional time averages f(S_n). Then bounded martingale differences (ξ_j,ζ_(j−1)ξ_j) have normalized predictable covariance diag(1,1) and cross bracket N^-1Σζ_(j−1)→0 uniformly in t, so functional martingale CLT gives independent two-dimensional Brownian motion. Independently checked downset symmetric differences for all 8128 unequal pairs 0≤s<t<128; finite checks cannot prove the strong law.
